events.title: AI Engineer World's Fair 2026
events.description: The world's largest technical conference dedicated to building, deploying, and scaling AI systems. 6,000+ attendees, 300 speakers, 29 tracks including a Leadership Track.

score.reasoning: Highest-density Tier 1 event of the year for the exact archetype. swyx invented the 'AI Engineer' job category — attendees ARE the FDE/Staff Engineer profile. 4 days = 4 nights of unofficial after-parties where the real hires get sourced.
score.suggestedAction: Apply to speak — talks are the warmest possible inbound channel for the role.

events.title: AI Council 2026
events.description: 3-day SF conference. 10 tracks, 1,500+ attendees. Speakers from OpenAI, Vercel, Hugging Face, Databricks.

score.reasoning: Speaker roster includes OpenAI, Vercel, Hugging Face, Databricks — exactly the AI-native firms in the candidate target list. 1,500 attendees with 10 tracks = high archetype density in the hallway track.
score.suggestedAction: Register, attend all 3 days, focus on hallway track and after-parties.

events.title: Embodied AI Hackathon — Build agents that move, grasp, learn
events.description: Weekend hackathon at SPC. Participants build agents that move, grasp, and learn, with hardware provided.

score.reasoning: SPC is the canonical 'between things' community for technical founders — your only public entry without member sponsorship. Embodied AI theme attracts senior practitioners (hardware-in-the-loop = serious shipping). Weekend = 48hrs of hallway time.
score.suggestedAction: Apply as judge or mentor. Use the event to identify SPC members for warm-intro path to member-only dinners.

events.title: Generative UI Hackathon — A2UI, AG-UI, MCP Apps
events.description: AI Tinkerers monthly community hackathon focused on agentic UI primitives: MCP Apps, AG-UI, A2UI.

score.reasoning: Theme directly maps to agentic UI primitives — practitioners building production agent interfaces. AI Tinkerers attracts solo builders and small teams = failed-founder archetype hunting ground.
score.suggestedAction: Apply as judge or mentor for credibility platform + natural intros to every team.

events.title: Bond AI — SF / Bay Area's largest in-person AI community
events.description: Multiple events per month. 120k+ members. Largest aggregator of in-person SF AI events.

score.reasoning: Largest aggregator of in-person SF AI events. 120k member base = wide top-of-funnel. Lower archetype density than Tier 1 but high frequency means consistent presence is cheap.
score.suggestedAction: Subscribe + filter weekly for high-signal individual events.
